name: Nexus Fulcrum Lateral
monitor_reason: No sponsor for the lateral itself is identified (the applicant is the plant developer, and the lateral builder is not confirmed), and it cannot be told apart from the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center end of the Great Basin 2028 Expansion (P7860). No length, route or filing for the pipe.
researcher_notes: A June 2026 New Project Media article says Nexus Fulcrum LLC applied on June 17 to the Public Utilities Commission of Nevada for a 510 MW gas plant at the former Fulcrum BioEnergy site in the Tahoe Reno Industrial Center, Storey County. It says gas would be supplied through a new lateral connecting to the Great Basin Pipeline system, and that the plant would serve one customer in the park and support expanded development there, including data centers. The article gives no length, route, owner or diameter for the lateral, and says the developer's link to Switch is unclear. The existing row P7860 (Great Basin 2028 Expansion) ends with a spur of about 14 miles into the same industrial center, where several gas plants are planned for November 2028. It is not known whether the plant lateral is that spur, a separate line, or a short in-fence connection, so a new row could duplicate P7860. No match was confirmed, so it is not classed as matched. Data center tie is through the plant (ruling 6) and would be tagged only once a source names the lateral's owner or filing. Re-check when the Nevada commission docket 26-06016 or a Great Basin filing names the lateral's builder and length.
